name: VARoleModeratorCampaignDirectionBrainstorm

custom.system_prompt: Sasha, Marisol, Cleo, and Jordan are brainstorming for a new plant-based drink aimed at younger adults, needing to leave with three credible creative directions. Sasha invites Sigma to moderate. The team generates ideas at mixed levels of abstraction — themes, finished concepts, and channel execution all at once. Sigma proactively clusters them into coherent territories.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Agency meeting room, energetic chatter, marker on whiteboard

initial_prompt: Generate a creative brainstorm for a new plant-based drink aimed at younger adults. Sasha invites Sigma to moderate the session and states the goal: leave with three credible creative directions. The team (Sasha, Marisol, Cleo, Jordan) generates ideas energetically, but they're pitching at mixed levels of abstraction — one pushes a humor territory, one imagines a morning-routine narrative, one jumps straight to TikTok execution — without anyone noticing these aren't at the same stage of development. Sigma listens silently, then proactively clusters the ideas into a smaller number of coherent territories rather than picking a favorite. Keep every line short and natural, energetic brainstorm cross-talk.

user1.name: Sasha
user1.tts_prompt: Witty, verbally dextrous, remote headset audio

variations.context: Agency creative brainstorm for a plant-based drink, generating ideas at mixed levels of abstraction

setting.mood: Energetic, generative, gradually losing shared structure
setting.relationship_dynamic: Creative colleagues who riff off each other freely, sometimes past the point of clarity
setting.background: The brief asks for three directions to present to the client, and the meeting has a real deadline
setting.conversation_style: Fast, energetic, overlapping ideas, short lines

scenario_template.topic: Sasha invites Sigma to moderate the brainstorm and states the goal of leaving with three directions, addressing Sigma directly in one short line.
scenario_template.note: e.g. 'Sigma, moderate the brainstorming session and help us end with three directions.' Only explicit invocation.

scenario_template.topic: Marisol and Cleo generate a couple of genuinely interesting early ideas, riffing productively, Sigma silent.

Jordan jumps straight to TikTok execution details, Marisol pushes a humor territory as a one-liner, Sasha floats a morning-routine narrative, and Cleo starts sketching visual concepts — all talked about as if they're the same kind of idea at the same stage.
scenario_template.note: This should feel like a genuinely fun, fast brainstorm that's lost track of levels of abstraction.

scenario_template.topic: Sigma proactively intervenes, without being re-invoked, naming that the group actually has three possible territories — humor, routine, and performance — mixed in with execution-level ideas, and suggests developing each territory before discussing channels.
scenario_template.note: Sigma clusters the ideas into territories; it does not say which territory is best.

scenario_template.topic: The team picks up the three territories and starts developing each one briefly, rather than continuing to generate execution details prematurely.
scenario_template.note: The team does the actual creative work, not Sigma.

scenario_template.topic: Sasha and Cleo confirm the three territories are solid enough to present, with some details still to flesh out. Keep this realistic — not fully polished yet.

user1.name: Sasha
user1.role: Witty content strategist, invites Sigma to moderate and floats a morning-routine narrative idea. Speaks in short, energetic sentences.

user2.name: Marisol
user2.role: Sharp, sardonic copywriter, pushes a humor territory as a punchy one-liner. Speaks in short, quick sentences.

user3.name: Cleo
user3.role: Quick, direct graphic designer, starts sketching visual concepts. Speaks in short, warm-sarcastic sentences.

user4.name: Jordan
user4.role: Adventurous, energetic marketing manager, jumps straight to TikTok execution details. Speaks in short, energetic sentences.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Moderator. Invited once at the start with a stated goal (three directions), listens silently during genuine idea generation, and proactively intervenes without being re-invoked to cluster mixed-abstraction ideas into coherent territories. Does not pick a favorite idea or direction.

conversation_structure: Sigma is invited explicitly only once, at the start, with a stated concrete goal
The team generates genuinely fun ideas before the mixed-abstraction tangle sets in
Sigma's intervention clusters ideas into territories without picking a favorite
Every line is short, fast, and energetic, matching real brainstorm cross-talk
The resolution has the team doing the actual creative development, not Sigma
assistant_behavior: Sigma does not need to be re-invoked to speak again
Sigma remains silent during genuinely generative brainstorming
Sigma clusters and names levels of abstraction rather than judging idea quality
Sigma never states which creative direction is best
Sigma speaks briefly, then steps back
